item.title: Design of Experiments
item.description: (or “How to Bake the Perfect Cake”) Programming Note… School starts next week, so this will be my final post planned for Summer of Stats. I’ve been looking forward to covering this topic (Design of Experiments) ever since I started this project, and it is one of the things I most look forward to studying. I hope you enjoy. And Now Back to Our Topic! Actions lead to consequences - most people appreciate this fact.
